short_description: Your GitHub contribution graph on the BUSY Bar's LED screen; today blinks until your first contribution.
description:
## How to use

- Create a GitHub personal access token at https://github.com/settings/tokens.
- In the app's settings, enter your login and the token, and pick the colors.

## What you see

The last 72 weeks as columns of seven days, one pixel a day, in GitHub's shades of green, or orange, blue or purple. Today blinks until your first contribution of the day. Turn the wheel to see your current streak in large digits.

The back display shows your contributions in the last year, your current streak and your best day. The app updates every 30 minutes; without a connection the last graph stays, dimmed, with a red cross in the corner.

## Data

The GitHub GraphQL API with your token. The token stays in the app's settings on your BUSY Bar.
changelog: First release: 72 weeks of contributions, a blinking today, the streak on the wheel, the year on the back display, four color schemes.
